verdict.rationale: Mintlify documents a built-in agent in the web editor that can edit pages, reorganize navigation, update docs.json, search the repository, leave suggestions, and manage settings. A broader Mintlify agent researches, plans, and writes docs, then opens PRs for review. Tasks can also be handed off through scheduled or event-driven automations and by mentioning @mintlify in Slack. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of how well the agent completes delegated tasks.
